name: Absolute Incineration
effect: You unleash a blistering thermal assault that reduces flesh and armour alike to liquid. When you use a weapon with the Melta Trait at Short Range, increase both the ED and AP by +Rank.
flavor: Nothing survives the focused heat of a melta weapon wielded by a true master—armour runs like water, flesh becomes vapor, and even the most stalwart foe is reduced to a smoking crater.

name: Acute Sense
effect: Pick one of your 5 senses (sight, hearing, smell, taste, or touch). Whenever you make an Awareness Test based on that sense, you gain +Rank bonus dice.
flavor: Whether through genetic blessing, rigorous training, or augmetic enhancement, one of your senses has been honed to preternatural sharpness.

name: Adaptive Strategy
effect: When spending a point of Wrath to make a Narrative Declaration, you may roll a die if the GM approves your declaration. If this die rolls an Icon, the point of Wrath is not spent. If the die rolls an Exalted Icon, the results of the Narrative Declaration are more impressive than usual, and the Wrath point is not spent.
flavor: The Codex Astartes teaches that no plan survives contact with the enemy. You have learned to turn the chaos of battle into opportunity.

name: Aegis of the Emperor
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As an Action you may target a Human within 5m. Your target cannot be targeted by Psychic Powers for 1 hour. You can target yourself.
flavor: Your unwavering faith in the God-Emperor creates a spiritual barrier against the corrupting touch of the Warp.

name: Anatomical Scourge
effect: Your knowledge of anatomy and biology can be extremely useful for targeting vital organs with precision shots. You gain +2ED when making Called Shots.
flavor: Whether through medical training or psychic insight, you know exactly where to strike to cause maximum damage.

name: Angel Of Death
effect: Add +Rank to the total Damage Value of successful attacks with Chainswords, Chainaxes, Power Swords, Power Fists, Unarmed strikes, Bolt weapons, and any weapon with the ADEPTUS ASTARTES Keyword.
flavor: You are the Emperor's wrath made manifest, a harbinger of death descending upon His foes with terrible fury.

name: Angel Of Mercy
effect: Add +Rank to your Medicae (Int) dice pool to determine how many Wounds you can remove in a Regroup of an hour or longer. You can split the number of Wounds you remove between multiple characters.
flavor: Your healing touch brings comfort to the wounded and hope to the dying. In the grim darkness of the far future, such compassion is a rare gift.

name: Animal Companion
effect: Choose any Threat with the BEAST Keyword that is not an Adversary at your Tier. You have tamed a single creature of that type. It follows you and attempts actions in combat as you command, taking its own slot in the Initiative Order like an Agent. It does not interact with Wrath or Ruin, unless another ability indicates otherwise. If you suffer an attack whilst the creature is within half its Speed of you, it may take a DN 5 Initiative Test as a Reflexive Action. If it succeeds, the attack is redirected onto the creature. Slain creatures may be replaced for free the next time you visit the replacement creature's habitat, or a location where it is raised in captivity.
flavor: You have forged a bond with a creature of the wild, a faithful companion that will fight and die by your side.

name: Animal Wrangler
effect: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on any social Skill Test against a target with the BEAST Keyword. You may choose to use the Survival (Wil) Skill for any social Skill Tests against these targets.
flavor: You possess an innate understanding of animal behavior, allowing you to calm, command, or intimidate beasts with ease.

name: Arch-Performer
effect: Choose a type of performance appropriate for the 41st Millennium. If an enthusiast witnesses your performance, you gain +Rank bonus dice to social Skills targeting them for the rest of the scene. If you undertake a skill Test to determine the success of the performance itself, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice. If you practise your performing art during a Regroup, you reduce your Shock to zero.
flavor: Your artistic talents have been honed to perfection, capable of moving audiences to tears, fury, or devotion.
choiceDescription: Choose a type of performance (choral singing, organ playing, hagiographic recital, ritual dance, etc.)

name: Armour of Contempt

prerequisites.other: Must have received the Black Carapace

effect: You may spend a point of Wrath to roll Determination against Mortal Wounds as if a standard source of damage inflicted them.
flavor: Your hatred of the enemy is so profound that it forms a psychic ward, turning aside wounds that would slay lesser warriors.

name: Armourbane
effect: When you make a successful melee attack you can Shift Exalted Icons to reduce the target's Resilience instead of adding ED. Each Exalted Icon you Shift decreases the target's Resilience by 1. Your weapon must have one of the following Keywords: BLADE, CHAIN, FORCE, POWER FIELD.
flavor: You have learned to exploit the gaps and weaknesses in enemy armour, striking where protection is thinnest.

name: Arsonist
effect: When you inflict the On Fire Condition, your victims suffer an additional +Rank Mortal Wounds at the start of each of your Turns. The DN for the Athletics (S) Test for your victims to remove the Condition is also increased by +Rank.
flavor: Fire is your art form, and you have perfected the craft of making it burn hotter and longer.

name: Assault Doctrine
effect: You receive a Bolt Pistol, Astartes Chainsword, Aquilla Mark VII armour, and Jump Pack. You gain additional +Rank AP on any melee weapon or ranged weapons with the Pistol Trait.
flavor: You are an angel of death, descending from the sky with bolt pistol blazing and chainsword roaring.

name: Augmetic
effect: You possess a mechanical augmentation that enhances your abilities. You may select two augmetics of Rare or lower rarity, or a single Very Rare augmetic. You may take this Talent more than once.
flavor: The flesh is weak, but the machine endures. You have replaced parts of your mortal body with the blessed gifts of the Omnissiah.
choiceDescription: Choose augmetics (two Rare or lower, or one Very Rare)

name: Battle Focus
effect: When you make a ranged attack, move up to your Speed as a Free Action. Use up to Rank times per combat, never more than once per Turn.
flavor: Like all Asuryani warriors, you have mastered the art of fluid movement in combat, firing with deadly accuracy while in constant motion.

name: Battle-Psyker
effect: When you successfully use a psychic power that forces targets to take a Test to resist its effects, the DN of that Test is increased by +Rank.
flavor: You have honed your psychic abilities for combat, overwhelming your enemies' mental defenses with practiced ease.

name: Battle Psyker (Aeldari)
effect: When you successfully activate a Runes of Battle power, you activate both of the power's listed effects, rather than just one.
flavor: Your mastery of the Runes of Battle allows you to channel their dual nature simultaneously, blessing allies while cursing foes.

name: Berzerker
effect: The very sight of blood energises you in battle. Whenever you see an individual within 30 metres of you suffer a Critical Hit or the Bleeding Condition, you gain 1 point of Wrath. The GM may ask you to make a DN 1 Corruption Test whenever this Talent is activated.
flavor: The smell of blood drives you into a killing frenzy. Such fury is a double-edged sword—powerful, but potentially corrupting.

name: Betrayer
effect: You can make mortal sacrifices to the Chaos Gods to gain their favour. You gain +1 Corruption. You can sacrifice a willing or unconscious individual to gain a point of Wrath.
flavor: The Dark Gods demand blood, and you are willing to pay the price. Each sacrifice brings you deeper into their embrace.

name: Beyond Mortality
effect: If you die and an ally returns part of your body to the Dark City, a Haemonculus Coven restores you. Each return grants 1 Corruption Point that cannot be resisted.
flavor: The Haemonculi of Commorragh can restore even the dead to life—for a price. Each resurrection leaves its mark upon your soul.

name: Binary Chatter
effect: You are adept at controlling mechanical constructs. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice whenever you attempt to instruct, program, or question a servitor or a similar construct.
flavor: You speak fluently in the sacred binary cant of the Machine God, commanding servitors and machine-spirits with ease.

name: Blade Artist
effect: When you use an AELDARI or DRUKHARI melee weapon, it gains Rending (Rank). If it already has Rending, increase the rating by +Rank.
flavor: You wield your blade with the cruel artistry of the Dark City, finding gaps in armor with contemptuous ease.

name: Blademaster
effect: Any weapons you use with the BLADE Keyword gain the Parry Trait. When using a weapon that already has the Parry Trait, you gain additional +Rank Defence against melee attacks.
flavor: Your skill with bladed weapons is exceptional, allowing you to turn aside enemy strikes with practiced grace.

name: Bladestorm
effect: When you use a SHURIKEN weapon, increase the Salvo rating by +Rank.
flavor: You unleash a whirling storm of monomolecular discs, shredding everything in your path.

name: Blindfighter
effect: You have trained to fight blind, relying on your instincts and other senses. The Blinded Condition does not affect your attack Tests using your Weapon Skill.
flavor: Darkness holds no terror for you. Your other senses guide your blade as surely as sight ever could.

name: Blood Must Flow!
effect: You know how to place your strikes to inflict haemorrhaging injuries. You may spend an Exalted Icon whenever you make a successful Weapon Skill attack to inflict the Bleeding Condition to your target.
flavor: You strike to wound, opening arteries and veins with surgical precision. Your enemies bleed out even as they fight.

name: Bloodhound
effect: Once you have the scent of a target, nothing can end your pursuit. Nominate a single creature as your target. You gain +Rank bonus dice to Survival Tests to track the target, and any attack Tests against them.
flavor: Once you have marked your prey, they cannot escape you. You will hunt them to the ends of the galaxy.

name: Bolstering Purity
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Reflexive Action, you can spend 1 Faith to bolster another's purity. Select one character with the IMPERIUM keyword within hearing range. The character automatically succeeds all Resolve and Conviction Tests until the end of the Round.
flavor: Your prayers strengthen the souls of those around you, shielding them from doubt and temptation.

name: Bolter Discipline
effect: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains Rapid Fire (2). If it already has Rapid Fire, add +Rank to the rating.
flavor: You have mastered the sacred art of the boltgun, placing shots with mechanical precision even under fire.

name: Bombardier
effect: Any weapons you use with the Blast Trait increase their Blast rating by +Double Rank.
flavor: You have an intuitive understanding of explosive trajectories and blast patterns, maximizing the devastation of every grenade and shell.

name: Bombardment
effect: Once per game session, you may call in a bombardment. The bombardment attack deals 20 damage +Double Rank ED to all targets within Rank x 10 metres of the designated target.
flavor: You have the authority and connections to call down fire from orbit or massed artillery. Few survive such concentrated destruction.

name: Born Survivor
effect: You can use Survival (Wil) instead of Medicae (Int) to remove your own Wounds, Shock, or Conditions. You do not suffer the usual DN penalties for using this ability on yourself.
flavor: You've learned to patch your own wounds using whatever is at hand. Formal training is no substitute for the will to live.

name: Brutalist
effect: Every melee weapon you wield has the Brutal Weapon Trait. If you make a successful melee attack with a weapon that already has Brutal, you deal an additional +1 damage.
flavor: Your raw strength allows you to deliver devastating blows that shatter bone and crush armor.

name: Built Tough
effect: Any weapons you carry with the Heavy (X) Trait halve their Heavy rating.
flavor: Your powerful frame allows you to wield heavy weapons with ease that others would struggle to even lift.

name: Bullet Hell
effect: Any weapons you carry with the PROJECTILE Keyword increase their Salvo rating by +Rank.
flavor: You believe in volume of fire. When you open up, the air fills with so many rounds that dodging becomes impossible.

name: Burning Bright
effect: Reduce the number of Traumatic Injuries required to kill you by 1 (minimum 1). Your party begins each session with +1 Glory (up to max).
flavor: Your spirit burns with an intensity that inspires those around you, even as it hastens your own end.

name: By His Will
effect: You gain +1 Faith. When you Help a character with the IMPERIUM Keyword, you add triple the number of bonus dice if you spend 1 Faith.
flavor: Through prayer and devotion, you channel the Emperor's blessing to aid His servants in their righteous endeavors.

name: Castigate the Witch
effect: You gain +1 Faith. When a Psychic Power targeting you fails to have an effect, you may spend 1 Faith as a Reflexive Action. The psyker who targeted you immediately suffers 2+Double Rank Shock.
flavor: Your righteous fury punishes those who would wield the witch's art against you.

name: Catechism of Fire
effect: Designate closest threat. Targets within 20m gain +2 ED on ranged attacks against that threat. Spend extra Faith: gain +3 ED instead.
flavor: Your words mark the enemy for destruction, focusing your brothers' fire with righteous precision.

name: Chainsaw Warrior
effect: When you use a weapon with the CHAIN Keyword, you may re-roll any ED dice you choose, but must accept the second result.
flavor: You have mastered the roaring fury of chain weapons, knowing exactly how to let the teeth bite deep.

name: Chaos Familiar
effect: You gain +2 Corruption. You gain a minion, a lesser daemon spawned from the Warp. It uses the Brimstone Horror profile (see p.349), but has a 1 in all Attributes. Its only Skills are Scholar (5) and Stealth (8). The daemon is fickle. To get it to take action, you must first succeed at an Opposed Persuasion or Intimidation Test. Once persuaded, the daemon goes to extreme measures to accomplish whatever task you set, to the best of its limited abilities. At the GM's discretion, if the minion sees you act against the interests of the Warp, the familiar immediately turns on you until it's destroyed or convinced of its mistake. If the familiar is slain, you must spend a Wrath Point to summon it again — which is time-consuming and requires the GM's permission.
flavor: A minor daemon has attached itself to you, whispering secrets and performing minor tasks—for a price paid in corruption.

name: Codex Duellist
effect: When a Threat attempts to roll Determination against damage you inflict with a melee weapon, the first (Rank) Wounds inflicted require 2 Icons each on the Determination Test to eliminate.
flavor: You have mastered the dueling forms prescribed by the Codex Astartes, striking with precision that defies defense.

name: Codex Innovator
effect: When executing a strategic plan you helped create, add +Rank dice to Leadership and Persuasion Tests. With 1 hour of planning, gain 1 bonus Wrath for Narrative Declarations.
flavor: Like Guilliman himself, you understand that the Codex is a guide, not a cage. Adaptation is the key to victory.

name: Concealed Cavity
effect: You have a hidden compartment on your person. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Stealth Tests to conceal small items. If you attack with a weapon from the compartment on the same Turn you retrieve it, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice on the attack.
flavor: A secret compartment hidden in clothing, cybernetics, or gear allows you to produce weapons when least expected.

name: Consecrated Light
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Reflexive Action, you may spend 1 Faith and present a holy symbol. You and any allies with the IMPERIUM Keyword within 15 + Double Rank metres gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Fear and Corruption Tests until the end of the Round.
flavor: The holy light of the Emperor shines through you, banishing shadow and strengthening the souls of the faithful.

name: Conversational Cogitator
effect: Before making a Cunning, Deception, Insight, or Persuasion Skill Test you can use your Tech Skill instead. You must complete a Regroup or Respite before using this Talent again.
flavor: Your augmetic systems analyze speech patterns, body language, and vocal stress, allowing you to navigate social situations through pure logic.

name: Counter Attack
effect: You can use this Talent whenever an enemy targets you with a melee attack. After the enemy has completed their attack, you may make a single melee attack against that enemy. This is treated as your Reflexive Action, but you may Counter Attack up to Rank times per Round. You may not apply any other Talents, Abilities, or combat options to a Counter Attack. If you Counter Attack, you cannot take any Move Actions on your next turn.
flavor: Every enemy attack creates an opening. You have trained to exploit these moments with lethal precision.

name: Counter-Curse
effect: You gain +Rank on Tests to Deny The Witch. Once per session, you can Deny The Witch as a Reflexive Action.
flavor: You have studied the ways of the Warp and learned to unravel the enemy's psychic workings.

name: Crux Terminatus
effect: Begin with Terminator armour. Comes with Storm Bolter and Power Fist/Chainfist. Various weapon swaps available. Chaplains get Crozius, Librarians get Force Weapon.
flavor: You have earned the right to wear the ancient Tactical Dreadnought Armour, becoming a walking fortress of ceramite and adamantium.

name: Deadshot
effect: You are a skilled shot, trained to carefully target your enemies' weak points. When you take the Aim action and make a Called Shot you double the bonus ED you receive.
flavor: Patience and precision are your watchwords. When you take time to aim, your shots find their mark with devastating effect.

name: Death From Above
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice to attacks from higher ground. You can climb at normal Speed without a Test. You can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds from falling.
flavor: You fight best when descending upon your foes, using gravity and momentum to enhance your strikes.

name: Death Or Glory!
effect: Whenever you are required to make a Fear Test, you may choose to instantly Charge the source of Fear, if you are able to, and make a single melee attack. Make the Fear Test after this attack resolves if the target is still alive. If you are in combat after the Fear Test resolves, you sacrifice your first Turn.
flavor: Fear drives lesser warriors to flee. You channel that terror into a desperate, furious assault.

name: Deathworld Veteran
effect: Choose one environmental hazard. You gain +Rank on Toughness Tests to resist its effects, and +Double Rank to Medicae and Survival Tests against that hazard. Can be purchased multiple times.
flavor: You survived the horrors of a death world, learning to endure conditions that would kill most humans.
choiceDescription: Choose an environmental hazard (suffocation, extreme heat, extreme cold, radiation, poisons, etc.)

name: Dedicate The Kill
effect: You may sacrifice your Move to nominate an Elite or Adversary as your target. If you personally kill your target in melee combat, you regain 1 Faith.
flavor: You name your foe and swear to destroy them in the Emperor's name. Such dedications are holy oaths.

name: Deductive
effect: As a Simple Action, you may use this Talent to make an Intellect-based Skill Test to recall or notice something about a target. The target can be anything, from a mag-locked door with a cantankerous machine spirit to an inscrutable Planetary Governor. If you pass the Test, the GM may give you information based on the Skill you used to make the Test. You also gain +Rank bonus dice to any Test made against that target that utilises this information. You may give this bonus to an ally if you communicate what you have learned.
flavor: Your keen mind picks up on details others miss, turning observation into tactical advantage.

name: Deductive Genius
effect: You can spend 1 Glory for a clue on the fastest way to proceed with your current mission. The GM will provide an honest answer based on what you know.
flavor: Your analytical mind can piece together clues that others would overlook, finding the thread that leads to the answer.

name: De-Escalator
effect: When making a Shot To Disarm with an Unarmed Strike, you do not suffer DN penalties for a Called Shot. The DN for opponent's Strength Test equals the Damage you'd have inflicted.
flavor: You know how to end a fight without killing—a rare skill in the 41st Millennium.

name: Deflect Shot
effect: When wielding a weapon with Parry and POWER FIELD or FORCE Keyword, the Defence bonus also applies against ranged attacks. On a miss with a Complication, the attack hits the attacker.
flavor: Your reflexes and blade-work are so swift that you can deflect incoming fire back at its source.

name: Deliverance from the Daemonic
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Combat Action, you may spend 1 Faith to target a CHAOS enemy within hearing range with an Opposed Willpower Test. If you succeed, the enemy suffers 1d3 +Rank Mortal Wounds. DAEMON Threats can't roll Determination to reduce this damage.
flavor: Your faith is so pure that your prayers burn the daemonic like holy fire.

name: Devastator Doctrine
effect: You receive Aquilla Mark VII armour and one Heavy Bolter, Heavy Flamer, Lascannon, Missile Launcher, Multi-Melta, or Plasma Cannon. You gain +Rank AP when using this weapon.
flavor: You are a master of heavy weaponry, laying down devastating suppressive fire or obliterating armored targets.

name: Devotees
effect: Through reputation or assignment, you have gathered a number of followers that will do whatever you ask. If you are attacked, they intervene. Your devotees are a Mob of any Troop level Threat. A number of devotees equal to Double Rank +2 have decided to follow you. You may use the stats presented in Chapter 14 for each devotee, or use the following rules: Devotee Attributes are equal to 1 + Double Rank; Devotee Skills are equal to 1 + Double Rank; A devotee's Attributes and Skills cannot be higher than your own. Whenever you are hit by any form of attack, any of your devotees may make a DN5 Initiative Test as a Reflexive Action. If they succeed, the attack kills the devotee instead of hitting you. Slain devotees may be replaced for free with new devotees the next time you visit a major encampment or city. If you take this Talent more than once, you gain more devotees of the same type you already possess. If you already have followers from an archetype ability, this Talent provides additional followers of that type instead.
flavor: Your charisma and cause have attracted a band of loyal followers willing to die for you.

name: Die Hard
effect: You're hard to kill. When you suffer more Wounds than your Maximum Wounds, you are not Dying. Roll once on the Memorable Injuries table and heal 1 Wound. You may not use this Talent again until you complete a Regroup.
flavor: Wounds that would kill a lesser being only make you angrier. You refuse to die until your work is done.

name: Dig In Deep
effect: When in cover, you gain +2 Defence (instead of +1) if less than half concealed, and +4 Defence (instead of +2) if more than half concealed. Gain +Rank Resilience against Shoot Through Cover.
flavor: You know how to make the most of any cover, presenting the smallest possible target to the enemy.

name: Dirty Fighter
effect: Whenever you make an Interaction Attack and shift 2 Exalted Icons, you can inflict an additional Condition (Blinded, Prone, Restrained, or Staggered).
flavor: Honor is for fools. You fight to win, using every dirty trick in the book.

name: Disarming Stare
effect: When you succeed on an Interaction Attack using Intimidation, your enemy is Staggered, in addition to other effects.
flavor: Your gaze alone is enough to freeze enemies in their tracks, their courage failing under your withering stare.

name: Disciple Of The Holy Trinity
effect: You add +Rank to the Damage of any weapons you use with the BOLT, FIRE or MELTA Keywords.
flavor: You have mastered the sacred trinity of the Adepta Sororitas: the cleansing fire, the holy bolt, and the purifying melta.

name: Discipline Savant

prerequisites.other: At least 2 psychic powers from a single Discipline

effect: Select a psychic discipline in which you have at least 2 powers. Whenever you make a Psychic Mastery Test to activate a power from that discipline, reduce the DN by 1.
flavor: Your mastery of a particular psychic discipline makes wielding its powers almost effortless.
choiceDescription: Choose a psychic discipline in which you have at least 2 powers

name: Disruptive Launch
effect: When equipped with a Jump Pack, you can spend a Shift on melee attacks to inflict Hindered (1) on engaged enemies. Additional Shifts target more enemies or increase the penalty.
flavor: Your descent from above is so violent that it staggers and disorients those caught in your landing zone.

name: Disturbing Voice
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice to Intimidation and Leadership Tests when you use your voice. Any Fellowship Test made with someone likely to be put off suffers +2 DN penalty.
flavor: Your voice carries an unsettling quality that commands attention—and fear—from all who hear it.

name: Divine Guidance
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Combat Action, you can spend 1 Faith to give the Emperor's guidance. Select one character with the IMPERIUM Keyword within hearing range. The character gains +Double Rank bonus dice to Ballistic Skill Tests for 1 Round.
flavor: Through prayer, you channel the Emperor's wisdom, guiding the aim of His faithful servants.

name: Dual Wield
effect: When you wield one weapon in each hand the DN penalty for using the Multi-Attack option is reduced by 2. Each weapon must have the Pistol Trait or be a one-handed melee weapon. You may also use a different weapon you are wielding for each of your Multi-Attacks, rolling damage separately for each weapon.
flavor: You have trained to fight with a weapon in each hand, striking from multiple angles simultaneously.

name: Duty Until Death
effect: Whenever you suffer more Wounds than your Max Wounds, you can use this Talent. You may take your next Turn normally; you begin Dying at the end of that Turn. You may choose to take your next Turn immediately after activating this Talent, potentially interrupting an enemy's Turn. If you roll a Complication on any Test, you take a Traumatic Wound.
flavor: Your devotion to duty is so absolute that even death cannot stop you from completing your final task.

name: Echo of Sanguinius
effect: After a Respite, declare you have had a vision. Ask the GM one question about your mission. Until next Respite, you are affected by the Blood Angels gene-seed flaw.
flavor: The blood of the Great Angel flows through your veins, granting prophetic visions—at a terrible price.

name: Eliminator
effect: When you have a Stealth Score and attack an enemy unaware of you, you may add your Stealth Score as ED, in addition to Surprise Attack bonuses.
flavor: You strike from the shadows with lethal precision, eliminating targets before they know you're there.

name: Enviable Grace
effect: Difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed. You may Fall Back as a Move. You are immune to Staggered. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Tests to remove Restrained.
flavor: Your movements are fluid and graceful, allowing you to navigate obstacles that would hinder lesser warriors.

name: Escape Artist
effect: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to all attempts to escape any form of bondage, be it mechanical bonds or an individual Grappling you.
flavor: No chain can hold you, no grip restrain you. You always find a way to slip free.

name: Ever Vigilant
effect: You never let down your guard. You gain +Double Rank to your Passive Awareness.
flavor: Your senses are always alert for danger, even when you appear relaxed or asleep.

name: Exhortation of Rage
effect: Targets within 20m add +1 ED on successful melee attacks. Spend extra Faith: +1 die to melee attacks, and effect lasts an additional round.
flavor: Your battle-cry fills your brothers with righteous fury, driving them to strike harder and faster.

name: Fashionista
effect: When you requisition Clothing, you gain bonus dice on social Skill Tests equal to the Rarity of the Clothing, in situations where your appearance would make a positive impression.
flavor: You understand the power of appearance. The right attire opens doors that would otherwise remain closed.

name: Fast Draw
effect: You may draw a weapon as a Free Action. Any attacks against enemies who have not yet taken a Turn gain +Double Rank bonus dice.
flavor: Your weapon clears its holster before most can blink, giving you the crucial first shot.

name: Favoured By The Warp
effect: You may reroll any Perils of the Warp result. You must accept the new result.
flavor: The Warp seems to bend in your favor, sparing you from the worst of its punishments—for now.

name: Fear
effect: When you succeed on an Intimidation Test, you can force the target to make a Fear Test with a DN equal to 1 + Double Rank.
flavor: Your presence alone is enough to break the courage of lesser beings.

name: Fear Made Manifest
effect: Make an Intimidation Test as a Reflexive Action when encountering new foes. Apply results to each enemy individually. Once per encounter per target.
flavor: The sight of you in battle armor is enough to send lesser foes fleeing in terror.

name: Fearless
effect: You automatically pass any Fear Test. You are immune to Intimidation Interaction Attacks.
flavor: Nothing terrifies you. Neither daemon nor xenos, neither death nor darkness can shake your resolve.

name: A Feast in Famine
effect: When you prepare food for your allies during a Regroup, anyone who partakes in the meal besides yourself removes all Shock.
flavor: You know how to create comfort from scraps, lifting spirits with a hot meal no matter how meager the ingredients.

name: Feel No Pain
effect: You do not suffer a penalty to DN for being Wounded. Your Wounds Trait is increased by +Rank.
flavor: Pain is merely information, easily ignored. Your body absorbs punishment that would cripple others.

name: Feint Attack
effect: You can use Weapon Skill to make Interaction Attacks against enemies you are Engaged with.
flavor: Your feints and false attacks keep opponents off-balance, creating openings for decisive strikes.

name: First Response
effect: Once per combat, you can make a Medicae Test to remove Wounds, Shock or a Condition as a Simple Action instead of a Combat Action.
flavor: In the chaos of battle, you can deliver life-saving treatment with practiced speed.

name: Flagellant
effect: At the start of each day, you must spend 20 minutes (Terran standard) in prayer, and inflict Wounds to yourself equal to your Tier through self-flagellation. You may not roll Determination against these Wounds or allow them to be healed by any method other than through a Respite. As long as you are wounded in this way, you gain +Rank bonus dice to your Determination and Conviction rolls and may choose to become Frenzied (p.199) as a Combat Action. If you also have the Frenzy Talent, you may become Frenzied as a Simple Action. If you fail to flagellate yourself, you are overcome with shame and take a +2 DN penalty to all Tests until you flagellate again.
flavor: Through pain, you find purity. Your self-inflicted wounds are offerings to the Emperor, strengthening your faith.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
effect: Choose a proscribed subject. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Tests that benefit from this knowledge. GMs may spend Complications to award 2 Ruin instead of 1.
flavor: You have studied matters the Inquisition would prefer remain unknown. Such knowledge is useful, but dangerous.
choiceDescription: Choose a proscribed subject (daemons, heretical beliefs, a specific alien species, a secretive Faction, etc.)

name: Force Of Will
effect: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Willpower Tests to continue sustaining psychic powers when you suffer damage.
flavor: Your concentration is unshakeable. Even grievous wounds cannot break your psychic focus.

name: Frenzy
effect: You can use a Combat Action to become Frenzied.
flavor: You can unleash the primal fury within, trading precision for devastating aggression.

name: Furious Charge
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice to melee attacks made as part of a Charge action.
flavor: You hit the enemy like a thunderbolt, your momentum adding devastating force to your strikes.

name: Gallows Humour
effect: You can take a Simple Action to make a grim joke whenever you are Wounded or suffering from a Condition. Make a DN 2 Fellowship Test. If you succeed, you and any allies that can hear you recover Shock equal to your Rank plus the number of Icons rolled.
flavor: Even in the darkest hour, you can find something to laugh about. Your grim humor keeps spirits from breaking.

name: Gene-Wrought Might
effect: Add an automatic Icon to Tests involving physical might (like Athletics to lift debris). Such Tests take half as long as usual.
flavor: Your gene-enhanced musculature grants you strength beyond even other Astartes.

name: Gilead Combat Veteran

prerequisites.other: Must be of the Absolvers Chapter or have extensive Gilead experience

effect: Once per encounter, Narrative Declarations for routine codes, briefing info, or enemy disposition do not need GM permission.
flavor: Your extensive experience in the Gilead System has made you intimately familiar with its enemies and protocols.

name: Hammer of Wrath
effect: When equipped with a Jump Pack, spend one Wrath to make any attack as part of a flying Charge deal Mortal Wounds for damage.
flavor: You descend like a meteor, your impact alone enough to shatter bone and crack armor.

name: Hand Of The Emperor
effect: You gain +1 Faith. You may spend 1 Faith as a Reflexive Action to double the Speed of an IMPERIUM character for 1 round. This character must be in hearing range.
flavor: The Emperor's strength flows through you, lending His servants supernatural swiftness.

name: Hardy
effect: As a Combat Action, you can make a DN 3 Toughness Test. On a failure you recover 1 Shock. On a success you recover 1 + Double Rank Shock. Each Shifted Exalted Icon recovers an additional point of Shock.
flavor: Your constitution is remarkable. You shake off fatigue and trauma that would incapacitate others.

name: Hatred [Any]
effect: Select a Keyword to be the focus of your hatred. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on melee attacks against targets that have the chosen Keyword. You suffer a +2 DN penalty whenever you interact socially with individuals of the chosen Keyword.
flavor: Your burning hatred for a particular foe drives you to fight with savage intensity against them.
choiceDescription: Choose a Keyword to be the focus of your hatred

name: Hive Explorer
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice to Survival and Stealth Tests in hive or urban environments.
flavor: The sprawling depths of hive cities are your natural habitat. You navigate their dangers with practiced ease.

name: Honed to Lethality
effect: When using a weapon with the POWER FIELD Keyword, increase the AP by +Rank.
flavor: You have learned to angle power weapons for maximum penetration, slicing through armor like paper.

name: Identify Weakness
effect: Make a Skill Test to size up an Elite or Adversary for weaknesses. When you or informed allies attack that target, inflict +Double Rank additional ED.
flavor: Your analytical eye can spot vulnerabilities that others miss, turning that knowledge into deadly advantage.
choiceDescription: Choose which skill you use for this talent (must be 3+)

name: Imposing Presence
effect: You can substitute Willpower for Strength on Intimidation Tests. You gain +Rank bonus dice if wearing armour with the HEAVY Keyword.
flavor: Your force of personality is as imposing as any physical threat. Clad in heavy armor, you are truly terrifying.

name: Improvised Weaponry
effect: Make a Survival or Tech Test to fashion a crude weapon. Shifts can halve crafting time, increase Damage by +Rank, or add various Traits.
flavor: Give you scrap metal and time, and you'll produce a weapon capable of killing.

name: In His Name
effect: You gain +1 Faith. Whenever you target a character with the IMPERIUM Keyword with a Persuasion or Leadership Test, you can spend 1 Faith to add +Double Rank bonus dice to your pool.
flavor: Speaking in the Emperor's name, your words carry divine authority that compels the faithful to action.

name: Inner Circle Secrets

prerequisites.other: Must know the secret of the Fallen

effect: You do not need to pay Glory to be considered aware of ambushes. Reduce DN of Cunning and Scholar Tests to unearth betrayal by 2.
flavor: You know the Chapter's darkest secret, and that knowledge has made you ever vigilant against treachery.

name: Insensible to Pain
effect: You may roll Determination against attacks that deal Mortal Wounds. You do not suffer DN penalties for being Wounded, unless you have suffered more than Double Rank Wounds. When you are Dying, you do not fall Prone, and suffer no limits on the Actions you can take, unless you suffer Traumatic Injuries equal to or greater than your Rank.
flavor: Pain is an old friend to the Drukhari. You have learned to embrace it, drawing strength from agony.

name: Inspired Blessing
effect: You gain +1 Faith. You may make an inspirational statement or prayer as a Combat Action. Spend 1 Faith to restore 1d3 + Double Rank Shock to you and all allies with the IMPERIUM keyword within 15 + Double Rank metres.
flavor: Your words of faith restore the spirits of the faithful, turning despair into renewed determination.

name: Investigative Omophagy
effect: When you eat the flesh of a sentient creature, you may ask the GM one question. You may also use the creature's Attribute+Skill pool for one Skill until the next Regroup.
flavor: The Omophagea allows you to absorb memories and skills from consumed flesh—a disturbing but useful ability.

name: Jargon [Skill]

prerequisites.other: Rating 1+ in: Ballistic Skill, Medicae, Pilot, Scholar, Survival, Tech, or Weapon Skill

effect: When you take this Talent, you must pick which of your Skills it applies to from the list in the Requirements section above. During any social encounter you can make a Skill Test using your Jargon Skill. The DN is determined by the GM based on how friendly the target is to you. If you fail, everyone around you ignores your incoherent babbling. If you succeed and the target is interested or trained in the Skill, they are likely to become more friendly to you (see p.168). If the target doesn't share your knowledge and slang, they stand stupefied whilst you babble — they are distracted, unable to get away from your conversation for up to 20 minutes (Terran standard).
flavor: You speak the specialized language of your profession, forming instant bonds with fellow practitioners.
choiceDescription: Choose which skill's jargon you are fluent in

name: Journeyman Craftsworker
effect: Choose a type of trade that does not involve the creation of Wargear. If an enthusiast witnesses your creations, you gain +Rank bonus dice to social Skills targeting them. If you undertake a Skill Test for the crafting itself, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice. If you practise your trade during a Regroup, you reduce your Shock by your Rank.
flavor: Your skilled hands create works that impress connoisseurs and bring you peace in troubled times.
choiceDescription: Choose a type of trade (carpentry, cartography, jewellery, masonry, painting, sculpture, etc.)

name: Legacy of Sorrow
effect: You no longer suffer the penalty from the Intense Emotion Species ability. The group gains +1 Glory every time you recover from Dying.
flavor: You have embraced the sorrows of your dying race, transforming grief into a source of strength.

name: Legacy of the Primarch
effect: Once per session, reduce DN of a specific Test by Rank based on your Chapter: Blood Angels (melee), Dark Angels (Investigation), Imperial Fists (siege), Iron Hands (Willpower w/augmetics), Raven Guard (Stealth), Salamanders (Fire/Melta), Space Wolves (Awareness), Ultramarines (any by 1), White Scars (Pilot).
flavor: The genetic legacy of your Primarch manifests in moments of need, granting you his particular gifts.

name: Let The Galaxy Burn
effect: You gain +1 Corruption. Whenever you incapacitate an Adversary or Elite opponent, the group gains +1 Glory, up to a maximum Glory of Double Rank per encounter.
flavor: Destruction is its own reward. Each worthy foe you fell empowers your warband.

name: Lhamaean
effect: As a Simple Action, you may enhance the toxins of a weapon you handle that has the Inflict (Poisoned) Trait. The weapon gains +Double Rank ED until it is next reloaded.
flavor: You have learned the poisoner's art from the Lhamaean sisterhood, coating your weapons with virulent toxins.

name: Lightning Reflexes
effect: Once per combat, you can Seize The Initiative without spending Glory. Additionally, once per combat, when the GM spends 1 Ruin to Seize The Initiative, you can spend 1 Glory to cancel the effect.
flavor: Your reflexes are supernaturally fast, allowing you to act before others even realize the threat.

name: Lip Reader
effect: You have learnt how to read lips. The GM may call for an Awareness (Int) Test to read lips successfully depending on the environment, the speaker's Species, and the language spoken. The default DN is 3 and may be modified as the GM sees fit.
flavor: Distance and silence are no barrier to your understanding. You can discern words from movement alone.

name: Litany of Faith
effect: Targets within 20m may roll Determination for Mortal Wounds as if typical damage. Spend extra Faith: may reroll a single Determination die against Mortal Wounds.
flavor: Your prayers bolster the faith of your brothers, allowing them to endure wounds that should be fatal.

name: Litany of Hate

prerequisites.other: Gained when learning any Litany of Battle

effect: Spend 1 Faith. ADEPTUS ASTARTES within 20m may re-roll Rank dice with results of 1, 2, or 3 on melee attacks. Spend another Faith: +1 reroll die and +1 round duration.
flavor: Your voice rings with righteous fury, driving your brothers to strike again and again.

name: Litany Of Hatred
effect: You gain +1 Faith. You may spend 1 Faith and a Simple Action to recite a Litany of Hate. The effects of your Hatred Talent now apply to any of your allies with the IMPERIUM keyword within Rank x 10 metres.
flavor: Your chanted hatred spreads like wildfire, infecting the faithful with your burning rage against the enemy.

name: Lobotomised Efficiency
effect: You have been rendered immune to temptations of the flesh. You gain +Double Rank to your Conviction and Resolve. You no longer add your Tier to your Max Shock.
flavor: Surgical intervention has removed your capacity for certain emotions. You are more machine than human now.

name: Longshot
effect: If you spend a Full Round Action setting up a static firing position, the Long Range of your ranged weapons are tripled. Weapons with the Sniper (X) Trait instead increase their Long Range to one kilometre.
flavor: Given time to set up, you can make shots that others would consider impossible.

name: Loremaster [Keyword]
effect: Choose a Keyword (a bureau of the Imperium, a xenos species, or something esoteric). If you select another Species, you can speak their native language. Whenever you make a Skill Test related to the chosen Keyword, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice.
flavor: Your knowledge of a particular subject is encyclopedic, rivaling the data-stacks of the Administratum.
choiceDescription: Choose a Keyword to be highly educated in (a faction, species, or esoteric subject)

name: Luck of the Laughing God
effect: Once per Test, reroll a single Wrath Die. Cannot reroll more than once or reroll a Complication.
flavor: Cegorach's favor follows you, turning aside misfortune at crucial moments.

name: Manual Labourer
effect: Choose a type of occupational labour. You gain +Rank bonus dice to all social Skill Tests targeting individuals from the same background. If you undertake a skill Test for these labours, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice.
flavor: You know the value of honest toil, and those who share your trade respect you for it.
choiceDescription: Choose a type of occupational labour (construction, forge labour, mining, agri-farming, etc.)

name: Mark Of Chaos
effect: You gain +1 Corruption. Select one of the five options: Nurgle (+1 Toughness), Khorne (+2 dice on All-Out Attack, can't be PSYKER), Slaanesh (+2 dice on Awareness and Persuasion), Tzeentch (gain PSYKER keyword or one minor power), Undedicated (+Rank dice to one chosen skill).
flavor: You bear the mark of a Chaos God upon your soul, forever bound to their dark service.
choiceDescription: Choose which Chaos God to dedicate yourself to

name: Martyr's Rites
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Simple Action, you may spend 1 Faith to recite last rites. Select one IMPERIUM character within hearing range. The target removes the Prone Condition if they have it. For the next 24 hours, the target doesn't suffer the Prone Condition when they are Dying, aren't restricted on Actions they can perform while Dying, or subject to the Exhausted Condition. The effect of those Conditions on Shock, Wounds, and Traumatic Injuries still apply as normal.
flavor: Your sacred rites prepare the dying for their final moments, granting them the strength to act even as death claims them.

name: Martyr's Tears
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Simple Action you can select a human target to heal. Spend 1 Faith and take a number of Wounds up to your Tier. The target recovers double the Wounds you sacrificed.
flavor: You take another's suffering unto yourself, healing through sacrifice as the Emperor once did.

name: Mastered Paths
effect: Select one of your Aeldari Paths. You gain an additional +Rank bonus to the bonus you receive from that Aeldari Path.
flavor: Your mastery of one Path has reached its pinnacle, granting you insights beyond ordinary practitioners.
choiceDescription: Choose one of your Aeldari Paths to master

name: Matchless Agility
effect: As a Reflexive Action when targeted by a ranged attack, spend 1 Glory before the Test. Gain +Rank Defence until the attack resolves. Once per Round.
flavor: Your reflexes are so swift that you can dodge bullets after they're fired.

name: Mendacious
effect: When you make a successful Deception Interaction Attack to inflict the Vulnerable Condition, your target reduces their Defence by 2 instead of 1. Shifts can further reduce Defence by 2 instead of 1.
flavor: Your lies are so convincing that victims lower their guard completely.

name: Mimic Voice
effect: Make an Awareness Test when you listen to an individual speak for at least 1 hour. If you succeed, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice whenever you make a Deception Test to mimic this voice. You can memorise voices equal to your Intellect.
flavor: Your voice is a weapon of deception. You can perfectly reproduce any voice you've studied.

name: Mob Rule
effect: When you command two or more Orks, you and all allied Orks within 15 + Double Rank metres may add +Double Rank bonus dice to Resolve Tests.
flavor: Da more Boyz, da 'arder we fight! Your presence inspires nearby Orks to stand their ground.

name: More Dakka!
effect: The Salvo value of any weapon you wield is increased by +Rank.
flavor: You subscribe to the Ork philosophy that there's no such thing as too much firepower.

name: Mortal Understanding
effect: Reduce DN of Fellowship-based Tests by 2 when interacting with Humans. Once you succeed on a Test to overcome Infernal Inheritance fear, waive future penalties with that individual.
flavor: Unlike many Astartes, you remember what it was to be human and maintain connections with mortal folk.

name: No Escape
effect: Enemies Engaged with you cannot use the Fall Back Combat Action. Additionally, you gain +Rank bonus dice on Reflexive Attack Tests.
flavor: Once you close with an enemy, they cannot escape. Your blade finds them before they can disengage.

name: Noble Peer
effect: You are a member of a renowned noble class. Whenever you are in a social situation where status plays a factor, gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Influence Tests and any Skill Tests involving social interaction.
flavor: Your noble bloodline opens doors throughout the Imperium. Lesser folk defer to your authority.

name: Old Reliable
effect: When you use a weapon with the LAS Keyword and the Reliable Trait, rolling a 1 on the Wrath Die does not trigger a Complication. This effect does not apply when you are Dying. Additionally, whenever you use an effect that would expend Las Ammo, roll a Wrath Die. If you roll an Exalted Icon, you do not expend that Las Ammo.
flavor: Your lasweapon has been with you through countless battles. You know its every quirk and capability.

name: Orthopraxy
effect: As a Simple Action you can begin mentally reciting Ecclesiastical liturgies. As long as you sacrifice your Simple Action this way, you gain +1 bonus Willpower, for a maximum of Double Rank Rounds.
flavor: Through constant prayer and meditation on holy texts, you strengthen your will against the darkness.

name: Pain Glove Endurant
effect: You ignore penalties to Tests caused by pain. You are immune to Fear.
flavor: Years of conditioning in the pain glove have made you utterly indifferent to suffering and fear.

name: Paranoid
effect: Once per session when you have access to a communications device, you may ask your ring of contacts one question they may know. The GM rolls a secret Cunning Test and provides information based on the number of Icons rolled.
flavor: You trust no one, but you have cultivated a network of informants who trade in secrets.

name: Perplexingly Persuasive
effect: When you succeed on an Interaction Attack using Persuasion to inflict Hindered, your target suffers DN penalty of 2 instead of 1. Shifts increase the DN penalty by 2 instead of 1.
flavor: Your words have an almost hypnotic quality, leaving listeners confused and compliant.

name: Power From Pain
effect: First kill in combat: +Rank Determination. Second kill: +Rank Speed. Third kill: +Rank Resolve. Benefits expire at end of combat or if you don't kill in a Turn.
flavor: Each death feeds your dark hunger, making you stronger, faster, and more resilient.

name: Precision Shooter
effect: When you make a Called Shot, you do not suffer the usual +2 DN penalty.
flavor: Your marksmanship is so refined that targeting specific body parts is no more difficult than a center-mass shot.

name: Primaris Perspective
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice Resolve and Corruption Tests. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Scholar Tests regarding historical events from the 31st Millennium or earlier.
flavor: Born in a different age, you carry memories of a time when the Emperor still walked among His people.

name: Promethium Proficiency
effect: When using weapons with the Inflict (On Fire) Trait, you gain +Rank ED. Once per Round, you may gain 1 Wrath when you kill an enemy of the Imperium using such a weapon.
flavor: Fire is the Emperor's purifying wrath, and you wield it with righteous fury.

name: Rad-Saturated
effect: Whenever a creature enters Engagement with you or starts a Turn Engaged with you they make a Toughness Test with DN equal to Rank x2. If they fail, they are Hindered until the start of their next Turn.
flavor: Your body radiates lethal levels of radiation, a blessing of the Omnissiah that punishes those who draw too close.

name: Raiding Master
effect: Gain +Rank dice to all Tests to plan or execute a raid or ambush. Same bonus to detect or prevent enemy raids/ambushes.
flavor: The lightning-fast tactics of the White Scars are second nature to you.

name: Rapid Assault
effect: You can fire ranged weapons with the Assault Trait as part of a Sprint without an increased DN.
flavor: You fire with deadly accuracy even at full sprint, never breaking stride as you advance.

name: Recitation of Focus
effect: Targets within 20m extend ranged weapon ranges by short range. Reduce cover bonus by 1 and vision penalties by 1. Spend extra Faith: reroll Rank attack dice.
flavor: Your chanted prayers sharpen the aim of your brothers, guiding their shots to strike true.

name: Reclamator
effect: When you requisition Wargear you can choose to reduce the Value by Double Rank to a minimum of 1 (Rarity is unaffected). However, if you do so, the item cannot be used until you repair it. By default, this requires 8 hours of work and a successful Tech (Int) Test, with a DN equal to the Wargear's original Value + Rarity. Shifts can be used to halve the repair time. If you do not have the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Keyword, this activity is considered illegal, a violation of both Lex Imperialis and the Treaty of Mars.
flavor: You have a talent for salvaging damaged equipment that others would discard.

name: Repent!
effect: You gain +1 Faith. Spend 1 Faith and make an opposed Intimidation Test with +Rank bonus dice. If you succeed and the target has the IMPERIUM Keyword, they kneel and repent for Double Rank x 10 seconds.
flavor: Your commanding presence forces even the stubborn to acknowledge their sins before the Emperor.

name: Righteous Suffering
effect: You gain +1 Faith. Once per Turn, whenever you suffer one or more Wounds, roll a Wrath Die. If you roll an Exalted Icon, you gain +1 Wrath Point.
flavor: Your pain becomes righteous fury, each wound strengthening your resolve to destroy the enemy.

name: Righteous Wrath
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Combat Action, spend 1 Faith to gain +2 Wrath. You can sacrifice 1 Wrath to give an ally with the IMPERIUM Keyword that can hear you +1 Wrath.
flavor: Your holy rage is infectious, spreading to nearby faithful and driving them to righteous fury.

name: Rising Crescendo
effect: Move up to triple Speed when Charging. You do not provoke Reflexive Attacks when moving out of Engagement.
flavor: Your performance builds to a killing climax, your dance carrying you through the enemy untouched.

name: Rite of Fear
effect: You can trigger the Rite of Fear as a Combat Action. Characters within a cone (10m long by 3m wide) who lack ear protection must make a Fear Test with DN 2 + Double Rank.
flavor: Your vox-emitters release a shriek of binary terror that drives the weak-minded to panic.

name: Rite of Magnometrics
effect: You can pick up and carry metal objects up to 3 + Double Rank metres away without touching them. You can draw your body to any large metal object and hover above it. Effective range is Rank x 20 metres. Effective Strength is 1 + Double Rank.
flavor: Your implants generate powerful magnetic fields, allowing you to manipulate metal through pure will.

name: Rite of Pure Thought
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice on Resolve and Fear Tests, and to resist Persuasion and Intimidation Interaction Attacks. You gain +Rank bonus dice when making Investigation Tests.
flavor: Your cogitator implants filter emotion, leaving only cold, logical analysis.

name: Rite of Shroudpsalm
effect: You may activate or deactivate this Talent as a Free Action. While active, you do not register on auspices, pict-thieves, monoscopes, or other scanning/recording equipment. Anyone attempting to identify your presence uses their unmodified Awareness.
flavor: Your implants emit counter-signals that confound detection equipment, making you invisible to machines.

name: Rite of the Voltagheist
effect: When you are hit by a melee attack, or a Complication is rolled on an attack Test that targets you, your attacker suffers Shock damage equal to your Rank. Your attacker must pass a DN3 Toughness Test or be Restrained for one Round and knocked Prone on a Complication.
flavor: Your body crackles with electrical discharge, punishing those who dare strike you.

name: Rubicon Primaris
effect: Gain Bolter Discipline and Built Tough. Gain PRIMARIS keyword. Gain +2 Influence and 1 Uncommon Wargear. Replace armour with Mk X Tacticus.
flavor: You have crossed the Rubicon, undergoing the dangerous surgery to become Primaris. Many do not survive the procedure.

name: Rumoursmith
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice to Cunning Tests to hear the word on the street. Any Shifts can be spent to insert a new rumour into circulation that cannot be traced back to you.
flavor: You are a master of whispers and hearsay, shaping public perception one rumor at a time.

name: Sacred Radiance
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Simple Action, spend 1 Faith to emit divine light. Whatever you look upon becomes fully illuminated. For CHAOS or DAEMON characters, Tests against you increase DN by 1. If a Complication is rolled on a Test against you, the attacker gains Blinded.
flavor: Holy light radiates from you, banishing darkness and searing the eyes of the unholy.

name: Scion of the Forge
effect: When making a Tech Test to analyse or repair Imperial machinery or wargear, add +Rank dice.
flavor: You were trained in the ways of the forge, understanding the sacred machine-spirits that dwell within Imperial technology.

name: Scum Savvy
effect: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to any Test related to resisting the effects of chemicals. You gain +Rank bonus dice when making Cunning Tests.
flavor: Your time in the underhive has taught you every dirty trick and built up your resistance to toxins.

name: Secret Identity
effect: You maintain a secret identity that lets you move through the Imperium unnoticed. Work with your GM to define your secret identity. When your secret identity is challenged, you must make a Deception Test to maintain the illusion.
flavor: You wear a mask of ordinariness, hiding your true allegiance to the Inquisition behind a false identity.

name: Seer Councillor
effect: When another Psyker within 10m successfully activates a power, they automatically gain an extra Exalted Icon for Potency.
flavor: Your psychic guidance amplifies the powers of those around you, like a lens focusing light.

name: Shadow Haunter
effect: You have excellent night vision, navigating darkness almost as easily as daylight. All DN penalties due to darkness are reduced by -1.
flavor: Darkness is your ally. You see clearly where others stumble blind.

name: Shield Bash
effect: If you are carrying armour with the Shield Trait, you can use it as a melee weapon: Damage (S)+AR, ED 1, AP 0 (or equal to shield's AR if Power Field), Traits: Inflict (Hindered). Shifts can increase the DN penalty by 1 per Shift.
flavor: Your shield is not just for defense—it's a weapon in its own right, battering foes into submission.

name: Shield Of Aversion
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Simple Action, spend 1 Faith to activate. For the remainder of the encounter, the AP value of any attack that targets you or an ally within 10m is reduced by Double your Rank.
flavor: Your faith creates a barrier that turns aside the most devastating attacks.

name: Shield Of Faith
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Reflexive Action, spend 1 Faith to ignore a psychic power or effect until the end of the Round. Spend additional Faith to grant this to all allies with IMPERIUM keyword within 15 + Double Rank metres.
flavor: Your faith shields you from the corrupting touch of the Warp.

name: Shrewd Investments
effect: When you spend Wealth as part of a Requisition Test, roll dice equal to Wealth spent. You regain Wealth equal to the number of Exalted Icons rolled, up to the amount spent.
flavor: You have a nose for profitable deals, often recovering some of your investment.

name: Sidestep
effect: You can use Sidestep as a Reflexive Action whenever you are attacked in melee. You must declare before the Attacker makes their Test — doing so sacrifices your Move Action on your next turn. You gain +Double Rank Defence and Resilience for the attack. Once per round.
flavor: You slip aside from attacks with fluid grace, turning what should be killing blows into near misses.

name: Signature Saedath
effect: Master one saedath type (switch as Simple Action). Light: +Rank dice on Interaction Attacks. Dark: +Rank AP on melee. Twilight: +Rank dice when Glory equals Ruin.
flavor: You have mastered one of the sacred dance-forms of the Harlequins, embodying its nature in battle.

name: Signal Booster
effect: The range at which you can make Interaction Attacks using Tech is increased to 5 times your Intellect in metres. Shifts can increase the Defence or DN penalty by 2 instead of 1.
flavor: Your augmetic systems can broadcast data-attacks at extended range.

name: Silent
effect: You can move at full Speed when Moving Stealthily. Whenever your Stealth Score would be reduced, reduce it by 1 fewer.
flavor: You move like a ghost, making no sound even at full speed.

name: Simultaneous Strike
effect: You can accurately attack with two weapons at once. Choose if it applies to Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill (must have 4+ in chosen skill). Make any Attack Action that has a single target a Simultaneous Strike with two one-handed melee weapons or two Pistols. Add half of the secondary weapon's Damage value as ED.
flavor: Both hands work in perfect harmony, each weapon an extension of your deadly will.
choiceDescription: Choose which skill this talent applies to (must have 4+ rating)

name: Skilled Rider
effect: When riding a combat bike, Land Speeder, or similar swift vehicle, enemies making ranged attacks against you increase their DN by +2 if you moved 10m+ in your previous turn.
flavor: You and your vehicle move as one, presenting a blur of speed that's nearly impossible to target.

name: Skyrunner
effect: Gain +Rank bonus dice on Pilot Tests for Hover vehicles. Use lower of vehicle's Manoeuvrability or Initiative+Rank.
flavor: You fly anti-grav craft with the casual grace that only the Aeldari can achieve.

name: Smash Attack
effect: You gain +Rank ED to any All-Out Attack.
flavor: When you commit fully to an attack, you hit with bone-shattering force.

name: Special Weapons Trooper
effect: You may select one of the following weapons as standard Wargear, replacing your primary weapon: Combat Shotgun, Plasma Gun, Meltagun, Long Las, Flamer, Grenade Launcher (includes 3 frag and 3 krak grenades), or Hot-Shot Volley Gun (TEMPESTUS SCION only).
flavor: You have been entrusted with one of the regiment's special weapons, a mark of distinction.
choiceDescription: Choose your special weapon (Hot-Shot Volley Gun requires TEMPESTUS SCION)

name: Sphere Of Influence
effect: Spend 1 Glory to nominate a Faction Keyword. You may detail a junior member of the Faction in your vicinity. Roll a Wrath die: Exalted Icon means they owe you a favour; Complication means you owe them one.
flavor: Your network of contacts extends across multiple factions of Imperial society.

name: Spirit of the Pack
effect: Add +Double Rank dice to Tests involving natural wildlife. Such creatures treat you as causing Fear with DN equal to Rank +2.
flavor: You carry the predator's spirit, commanding respect from beasts and instilling fear in lesser creatures.

name: Statue Still
effect: You gain +Rank to your Stealth Score whenever you are perfectly still. You lose this benefit when moving silently. While using this ability, you can only whisper or use vox, potentially allowing you to Help allies. As soon as you undertake any other action, the bonus is subtracted from your Stealth Score and can't be restored until you generate a new Stealth Score.
flavor: When you freeze, you become nearly invisible, blending perfectly with your surroundings.

name: Stoic
effect: Either through a quirk of biology, surgical intervention, or traumatic injury, your face no longer betrays emotion. You impose a +Double Rank DN penalty on any Insight Tests made against you.
flavor: Your face is an unreadable mask, giving nothing away to those who would read your intentions.

name: Storm of Death
effect: When the only combat option you take in your turn is a Multi-Attack, the DN penalty is decreased by -Double Rank. Your turn ends after you complete your Multi-Attack.
flavor: You unleash a whirlwind of strikes, attacking multiple foes with blinding speed.

name: Strength from Steel
effect: Once per session, ignore a source of damage that would inflict Wounds equal to or less than the number of augmetics you have.
flavor: Your augmetic parts absorb damage that would cripple your remaining flesh.

name: Supplicant
effect: You gain +Rank bonus dice whenever you are appealing to one of your social betters, such as a planetary governor or a superior officer.
flavor: You know how to bow and scrape before authority, making a good impression on your betters.

name: Supreme Presence [Skill]

prerequisites.other: Skill Rating 4+ in: Athletics, Deception, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Tech

effect: When you make an Interaction Attack with the chosen Skill, you may select either 1 + Double Rank targets or a Mob of any number of Troops. The DN does not increase.
flavor: Your presence commands attention, allowing you to affect entire crowds at once.
choiceDescription: Choose which skill this talent applies to (must have 4+ rating)

name: Survivalist
effect: You gain +Rank to Passive Awareness when detecting BEAST creatures. You never suffer starvation in wilderness. You never lose your sense of direction. You always know how to find nearest shelter from environmental hazards.
flavor: The wilderness is your natural habitat. You always find food, shelter, and your way.

name: Swift Attack
effect: When making a Multi-Attack with melee weapons, you may make one additional attack.
flavor: Your blade moves faster than the eye can follow, striking again and again in rapid succession.

name: Sword of the Emperor
effect: A single Astartes target within 20m inflicts Mortal Wounds equal to your Rank on their next melee hit. Spend extra Faith: sustain for another round.
flavor: Your prayers make a brother's blade burn with righteous fury, cutting through armor as if it were nothing.

name: Techno-animist
effect: You can use Tech instead of Medicae to remove Wounds, Shock, and Conditions from targets with the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Keyword.
flavor: You heal the faithful of the Omnissiah by repairing their holy augmetics.

name: Telecryptographer
effect: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Tests to jam, intercept or decode enemy vox traffic. If any allies are equipped with a vox unit, you can spend a Respite to encrypt their communications.
flavor: You are a master of codes and ciphers, intercepting and securing vox transmissions.

name: Tenacious
effect: You recover 1 Shock for every Exalted Icon you roll when you roll Determination.
flavor: Your resilience is legendary. Each blow you endure only strengthens your resolve.

name: The Flesh is Weak
effect: You no longer need to breathe and you do not bleed (immune to Bleeding and Suffocation). You gain +Rank bonus dice to Tech Tests and Determination rolls. You suffer +2DN to Persuasion Tests. You may heal any Memorable or Traumatic Injuries.
flavor: You have replaced so much of your body with machinery that biological limitations no longer apply.

name: The Imperium's Sword
effect: Move an additional +Rank metres when you Charge. The Charge attack gains +1 ED, or +2 ED against Mobs.
flavor: You are the tip of the spear, striking the enemy with devastating force.

name: Touched By Fate
effect: You begin each session with an additional +Rank Wrath Points.
flavor: Destiny has marked you for greatness. Fortune smiles upon your endeavors.

name: Trademark Weapon
effect: Choose one of your weapons to become a Trademark Weapon. Whenever you make a successful attack with your Trademark Weapon, you deal +Double Rank additional ED. If you lose or destroy your Trademark Weapon, you can no longer receive any benefits from this Talent.
flavor: You have bonded with a particular weapon, and in your hands it becomes an instrument of destruction.
choiceDescription: Choose one of your weapons to become your Trademark Weapon

name: Transhuman [Attribute]
effect: Select one of your Attributes with a rating of 5 or higher. Whenever you make a Test using the selected Attribute, you gain +Double Rank bonus dice.
flavor: You have transcended normal mortal limits in one aspect of your being.
choiceDescription: Choose an attribute with rating 5+ to enhance

name: Transhuman Physiology
effect: When an attack deals less than Rank Wounds, convert them to Shock automatically. When converting Wounds to Shock, receive one less Shock per conversion (minimum 1).
flavor: Your superhuman constitution shrugs off wounds that would fell lesser warriors.

name: Trapmaster
effect: During a Regroup, Test Survival to set a trap. Success constructs a trap that can be activated as a Reflexive Action when an enemy moves. On a successful DN 3 attack Test, the trap deals 7 Damage, 2 ED, Blast (6), Brutal, Inflict (Prone).
flavor: You have a talent for constructing deadly traps from available materials.

name: Trip Attack
effect: When you succeed on an Interaction Attack using Athletics, your enemy gains the Prone Condition. Prone enemies Engaged with you can only remove the Condition by spending a Combat Action.
flavor: You knock foes off their feet and keep them down where you can finish them.

name: Trueborn
effect: Any DRUKHARI weapon you requisition is delivered with its first weapon upgrade installed (Value/Rarity of upgrade must not exceed weapon's).
flavor: As Drukhari nobility, you receive weapons of superior quality befitting your station.

name: Twin Focus
effect: The DN penalty from sustaining multiple psychic powers is decreased by 2.
flavor: Your psychic discipline allows you to maintain multiple powers with less strain.

name: Unbreakable Guard
effect: When you benefit from a Full Defence, your Defence is further increased by +Rank.
flavor: When you commit to defense, you become nearly untouchable.

name: Uncanny [Trait]
effect: Increase one of these Traits by +Rank: Conviction, Defence, Resilience, Resolve, Shock, Determination, Speed, or Wounds.
flavor: In one particular aspect, you exceed what should be possible for your kind.
choiceDescription: Choose which trait to increase by +Rank

name: Uncompromising Fire
effect: On your turn in combat, complete an additional Simple Action that does not involve significant physical motion (Awareness, Leadership, etc.).
flavor: Your mind works faster than mortal ken, processing information while your body fights.

name: Unnatural [Skill]
effect: Choose any Skill with a rating of 4+. When making a Test with the selected Skill, reduce any DN modifiers by -Double Rank, to a minimum of 0.
flavor: Your mastery of one skill is so complete that challenges others find daunting are trivial to you.
choiceDescription: Choose a skill with rating 4+ to enhance

name: Unremarkable
effect: Characters of a higher social class with the IMPERIUM keyword ignore you completely unless you attract attention. Anyone attempting to notice or track you in a crowded area, or trying to remember your face, suffers +2DN.
flavor: There is nothing remarkable about you. You blend into crowds and fade from memory.

name: Unshakable Vengeance
effect: You gain +1 Faith. Whenever you suffer one or more Wounds, you may spend 1 Faith as a Reflexive Action to immediately make a Bolter attack against the target that dealt you damage, and may reroll all dice that do not result in Icons.
flavor: Every wound you suffer only fuels your righteous fury, driving you to immediate retribution.

name: Verse of Holy Piety
effect: You gain +1 Faith. As a Simple Action spend 1 Faith to utter the verse. Any character with the IMPERIUM Keyword hearing the verse automatically fails any Deception Tests and suffers Shock damage equal to double your Rank.
flavor: Your sacred verse compels truth and punishes deceit in those who hear it.

name: Warden of Souls
effect: As a Combat Action during combat, succeed on DN 1 Resolve Test to regain Rank Wounds plus additional Wounds equal to Shifted Exalted Icons.
flavor: You draw upon the souls of the dead to heal your own wounds.

name: Warped Mind
effect: You may learn psychic powers from an additional psychic discipline. You may choose to take Corruption to reduce the XP cost (5 XP per Corruption point).
flavor: Your mind has been twisted by the Warp, granting access to forbidden knowledge at a terrible price.

name: Whatever The Cost
effect: You gain 2 Icons for every point of Wealth you spend on Requisition Tests, instead of 1. However, if you roll a Complication on a Requisition Test you lose 2 Wealth instead of 1.
flavor: You spare no expense to get what you need, for better or worse.

name: Whirlwind of Rage
effect: When attacking as part of a Charge, shift up to Rank Exalted Icons for +2 ED each instead of the standard +1 ED.
flavor: You crash into the enemy like a hurricane, each strike more devastating than the last.

name: White-Hot Death
effect: When you fire a weapon using Supercharge you add an additional +Rank ED.
flavor: You push plasma weapons to their limits, trading safety for devastating power.

name: Wild Attack
effect: Whenever you make an All-Out Attack you gain +Rank bonus dice. Additionally, you can choose to sacrifice Shock equal to your Rank. The All-Out Attack gains +ED equal to the Shock sacrificed.
flavor: You throw yourself into battle with reckless abandon, trading defense for devastating offense.

name: Wings Of Fire
effect: You fly with such confidence that jump packs are like extensions of your own body. You ignore the first Complication per scene related to moving by Jump Pack.
flavor: You soar through the air with preternatural grace, your jump pack an extension of your will.

name: Wise Orator
effect: Decrease DN to persuade loyal Imperial citizens. Neutral NPCs are treated as Helpful. Litanies of Battle last an additional turn after you cease sustaining them.
flavor: Your words carry the weight of ages, inspiring loyalty in all who hear them.

name: Wraith-Slipping
effect: Ignore penalties to Stealth Tests from your size, wargear, or lack of camouflage.
flavor: You move like a shadow despite your bulk, seeming to fade from sight even in plain view.

name: Battle Company Doctrine
effect: Gain Bolter Discipline, Built Tough, or Chainsaw Warrior plus another instance of Hatred. Gain +2 Influence and 1 Uncommon Wargear item.
flavor: You have proven yourself worthy of the Battle Companies, the core of the Chapter's fighting strength.
